integrity: The explicit 52-word witness is checked directly; the upper bound is reconstructed from all 286 vertices and 2255 conflict pairs, and the same implementation reproduces all published exact weight-three values through n=12.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is the single finite instance n=13, weight 3. Its upper bound is certified by a complete 0-1 optimization replay; no closed-form human-only upper bound, uniqueness classification, or result for n>=14 is claimed.
title: Exact first open three-token path packing number
